Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a factual error in the physics data used for the calculation. It claimed that the rolling resistance coefficient ($c_r$) for sand is approximately 0.003, whereas in reality, rolling on sand significantly increases resistance due to the energy required to displace and deform the granular material. Typical $c_r$ values for sand are much higher (often between 0.1 and 0.4, or even higher for heavy loads), while smooth hard surfaces have low coefficients (around 0.01–0.02). By incorrectly assuming sand has lower resistance than a smooth surface, the agent concluded the truck would roll faster, leading to the wrong answer (B) instead of the correct answer (A).
